resources.string: No community decorations yet. Make the first one!
Nothing sent in yet. Make one and it shows up here while it\'s reviewed.
Take “%1$s” out of the catalog? Everyone wearing it goes back to no decoration.
Draw a frame for avatars and send it in. Once Meldiq\'s team approves it, anyone can wear it, with your name on it.
Square, 128 to 1024 pixels (512 × 512 works best), PNG, WebP or GIF with a see-through background, up to 1.5 MB. Animated is fine.
Keep the middle circle empty: that\'s where the avatar goes.
Keep big pieces to the top and sides. The bottom strip sits right above the name, so keep it light.
Only your own original work. No art saved from the internet or another app, and no traced or edited copies of someone else\'s work. Copies are taken down and can cost you your Artist badge.
No nudity, gore, hate, or other people\'s logos and characters.

Get your first one approved and you earn the Artist badge, your decorations on your profile for anyone to try on, room for 6 waiting at once (3 until then), and a count of how many people wear each one.
I made this myself. It isn\'t taken from someone else or the internet.
Decorations are PNG, WebP or GIF images.
Decorations can be up to 1.5 MB.
Decorations are square; that image is %1$d × %2$d.
Decorations are 128 to 1024 pixels square (512 × 512 works best).
